headline: Agent data architecture, Google's MCP rule and an AI-forecasting debate
text: Kai Waehner compares a converged database with a lakehouse as the home for agent data, while Google will make agents use its own MCP servers for Workspace. Gemini 4 Neon is described as returning Google DeepMind to the frontier, and Dwarkesh Patel interviews Daniel Kokotajlo and Ege Erdil on what AI researchers should do next.
